_about: Queue settings for pull_queues.py --state WI. Every Wisconsin transmission owner sits in MISO (American Transmission Company in the east and center, Xcel's Northern States Power-Wisconsin and Dairyland in the west), so MISO is the one market. owner catches MISO's blank-state rows of Wisconsin's own owners (ATC, the We Energies, Alliant East, MGE, Dairyland, WPPI and Xcel Wisconsin names); shared_owner holds owners that serve other states and are not kept (Northern States Power Company of Minnesota, ITC, Great River Energy, Alliant West). known is hand-checked patterns, GEM plant id to regexes that name that plant in a point of interconnection or project name. Every match still says check; a county-only match is never a known match. Set 2026-11-17 from the MISO list itself.
